featured_reviews.name: fane 12
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smoothie Factory – Where Health Meets Indulgence!

Are you an athlete, a fitness freak, or just someone who’s tired of every food joint drowning your meal in sugar, oil, or butter? If stepping out to eat feels like a battle against unhealthy choices, then Smoothie Factory is your ultimate safe haven!

What makes them special? EVERYTHING is made fresh. No shortcuts, no preservatives—just pure, wholesome goodness.

We decided to put their healthy promise to the test, and here’s what we tried:

🥜 PB&J Protein Acai Bowl (4/5) – This bowl is a meal in itself! Packed with granola, banana, strawberries, blueberries, and a peanut butter drizzle, it’s as nutritious as it is delicious. Fair warning: it’s super filling, so come hungry!

🍓 Very Berry Smoothie (4/5) – A delightful mix of rich berries, soy milk, and honey, this smoothie nails the balance between sweet and refreshing. The texture? Thick and satisfying—exactly how a smoothie should be!

🍈 Guava Kiss (5/5) – If you love guava, this is a must-try. Bursting with tropical goodness, it’s easily one of the best guava-based drinks we’ve ever had.

🍊 100% Orange Juice (5/5) – No gimmicks, no additives—just freshly squeezed, pure orange juice. Simple, classic, and absolutely perfect.

🍦 Frozen Yogurt (5/5) – DO NOT leave without trying this! We had the Chocolate & Strawberry Frozen Yogurt, and let’s just say—it’s on another level. Creamy, rich, and guilt-free, it’s the perfect sweet treat.

Final Verdict: If you want to eat to your heart’s content without compromising on health, Smoothie Factory is the place to be. Fresh, flavorful, and packed with nutrition—what more could you ask for?

Disappointing Experience at Fresh Press Juice Store

I recently visited the Fresh Press Juice Store, but unfortunately, my experience was a letdown. The cashier's demeanor was unwelcoming, setting a negative tone from the start.

When I began placing my order, I was informed that they only had 300ml and 1L bottles available, despite their menu listing 500ml options. This limitation was frustrating, especially since I was looking forward to trying their juices in a specific size.

To make matters worse, when I attempted to order a pomegranate juice, I was told that it was out of stock. This was a major disappointment, as I had been craving it.

I hope the management takes steps to improve their inventory management and communication. It's essential to ensure that customers can order what they want, and that staff are knowledgeable about availability. With a few adjustments, I believe Fresh Press Juice Store can provide a better experience for new customers.

Suggestions for improvement:

- Improve inventory management to avoid stockouts
- Update menu boards to reflect available sizes and quantities
- Train staff to be more welcoming and communicative about availability and options

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been visiting Health juice center located at Matunga King Circle for almost 15years now . Their strawberry milkshake is the ultimate Best I have ever tasted & they have been consistently serving the same taste for so many years which is highly commendable .

When I came to know that Health juice centre is opened in Parel I had to visit it .
I had to meet someone for urgent discussion & was in the same vicinity hence decided to visit the Parel outlet .

The most interesting aspect of this joint is that everything served here is made from scratch fresh in front of you .

They have a wide range of delectable juices , shakes & sandwiches to choose from .
The rates are pocket friendly & the serving quantity is generous & filling for 1 person .
The service is really quick so you dont have to wait too long .They also have home delivery option in the vicinity if you wish to enjoy the hot sandwitches & chilled drinks watching netflix with your friends or family .

I always order the strawberry juice , strawberry malai & strawberry milkshake as they use frozen stawberries instead of artificial syrups & flavours which imparts real sweet tangy taste .

This is the main reason I am a patent customer of Health juice for so many years as it is impossible to find this level of quality in any other restaurant in Mumbai !

The vada pav & samosa grill cheese sandwitch is my top favourite as it is generously overloaded with vegetables served piing hot with chutneys & crisp potato chips .

This outlet also serves the famous street chaats of Mumbai which was exceptionally well made .The paani puri is a must try .

Do visit health juice centre if you are looking for healthy yet tasty food in the real sense of the term .

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a regular customer of their Valencia Orange for a good 4-5 months and I was pretty happy with the quality and purity of the juices.

But now, the composition of the juice has changed. It’s no longer 100% Valencia Orange Juice.The labels and on the bottle has also changed. There’s barely any pulp in it. The shelf life has increased to 3 months now compared to  45 days and the juice just doesn’t taste the same anymore. It feels adulterated. featured_reviews.review_text: I tried Coconut water from Raw Pressery. Regretted taking the first sip!! It tased like chemicals and had a really bad after taste. The bottle is still 5 months away from expiry. The smell of this Coconut water is also like strong chemicals. Not  recommended at all!

featured_reviews.name: S P
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been purchasing Raw Pressery juices for over a year and it's been a mostly good experience. However, over the last 1 month (end of May - June), I noticed two problems: (1) When I opened the juice bottles, they had a distinct stink at the rim. It is the kind of smell that lingers after using dirty dish water. In other words, I get the impression their bottles are not being cleaned and prepared under the right hygiene conditions at the processing plant. Reminds me of the roadside stalls where they dunk used utensils and cutlery into buckets of muddy-looking water. It's an awful sour smell that just ruins the whole experience of consuming an apparently fresh, healthy juice. And (2) The Orange juice has an awful after-taste. Almost like crocin or some sort of medication, may be even pesticide, has been crushed into it. I suspect the oranges are not being washed or scrubbed properly before they're juiced. Together, these two reasons have compelled me to stop purchasing Raw Pressery juices. To be sure of the quality, I bought juice bottles from 4 separate locations / businesses in the city. Unfortunately, I encountered the same problem. I complained to one of the business owners and have also shared my experiences with friends and family. The price point of the products is high (or at least not affordable for most / many), and the company is profiting from the idea of consciousness and purity -- for these reasons, it is extremely important that they observe the strictest product quality controls. I have communicated my concerns to the company and hope they take the necessary measures to fulfill their commercial promise of delivering an excellent product.

Have visited this restaurant twice now and have truly enjoyed the food here.
The food tastes so incredible here that it would be hard for you guess that it’s a full vegan restaurant!
The ambience is nice, it’s an open cafe type matching the near by cafes which gives it a nice spacious feel.
We ordered for the below items and we weren’t disappointed with any. There were absolutely no complaints.
1. Falaffair - deconstructed hummus with pita bread
2. Guac n chips - banana chips with guacamole
3. Nutty pesto bowl - mix of all green leafy vegetables with warm pesto sauce
4. Pad Thai salad - pad Thai noodles with veggies & peanut sauce
5. Jamaican joy burger - burger patty made of quinoa
6. Grinch pizza - a medley of greens veggies with but cheese on a gluten free base
7. Mongolian rice bowl - black bean pepper sauce with rice and tofu
8. Risotto - pink sauce risotto
9. Orange Choco cake - layers of orange and chocolate combining into a perfect cake
10. Chocolate cake - their decedent rich signature cake which melts in the mouth!
PRO TIP - ask them to warm the cakes and only then have it. You will thank me later!
For drinks we had the below
1. Decaf Americano - great coffee
2. Affogato - loved it.

All in all, had an amazing time and delicious food.
Shoutout to Alex our server, he was great!!

featured_reviews.name: A W
featured_reviews.review_text:
(1) I recently attended two weekend food workshops at Nature’s Basket in Phoenix Palladium Mall. The sessions featured four beautifully crafted recipes: Pear–Walnut Crostini with Goat Cheese, Spiced Pear & Almond Galettes, Prune Clafoutis with Spiced Prune Sauce, and Prune Thumbprint Cookies. (2) Chef Tania provided clear, thorough explanations of every step in the cooking process and encouraged participants to engage actively throughout. She welcomed questions with genuine interest and even addressed my broader culinary queries. Her calm and composed teaching style made the entire experience particularly enjoyable. She was ably supported by Chef Mandar and Chef Payal, who assisted her seamlessly during both workshops. (3) The workshop coordinator, Monalita, also deserves special recognition. Her warm personality and efficient handling of participants contributed significantly to the smooth running of the sessions. (4) The workshops are conducted in a dedicated room, equipped with a main kitchen platform for the chef and six island stations for participants. It is rare to find such a thoughtfully designed space for cooking workshops within a gourmet grocery store. (5) Nature’s Basket has long been a shopper’s delight. Its pleasant ambience, courteous staff, and high-quality products make it an ideal destination for all kitchen needs. The store’s wide selection of exotic ingredients is particularly appealing for food enthusiasts. (6) A practical note for visitors: the store is located on the third floor in the West Zone of the mall, useful information, as the East Zone is completely separated from it.

(Mobile photos: 6 & 7 Dec 2025)

Amazing Birthday Experience!

​We celebrated our daughter’s birthday at Nature’s Basket Artisan Pantry (Palladium), and it was phenomenal! The team hosted an incredible interactive party where the kids cooked a gourmet Italian meal—complete with a starter, main course, and dessert.

​The food was fantastic, and the birthday cake was absolutely yummy. A huge thank you to all the chefs who taught the kids, and a special shoutout to Monalita, Kajal, and the whole team for their warmth, flawless coordination, and making this day so special. Highly recommended!
